title: Handoff Debt: The Rediscovery Cost When Coding Agents Take Over Interrupted Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2606.02875v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks evaluate whether a single uninterrupted agent can resolve a repository issue. Real software work is messier: tasks are interrupted, reassigned, reviewed, and resumed from partial states left by another agent or engineer. We study this missing dimension through handoff debt: the rediscovery cost imposed when a predecessor's work is opaque or incomplete. Our takeover protocol interrupts a coding agent at deterministic handoff points, freezes the repository, and evaluates successor agents under four handoff views: repository state only, raw trace, summary notes, and structured notes. Across 75 source tasks, the protocol generates 181 handoff-point tasks and 724 takeover runs per successor model. Across three successor models, context-bearing handoffs reduce median agent events by 20-59% and cumulative prompt tokens by 42-63% relative to repository-only takeover. Solved-rate effects are smaller and model-dependent

translated_title: 交接债务：编码智能体接管中断任务时的重新发现成本
translated_abstract: 编码智能体基准测试评估的是单个不间断运行的智能体能否解决代码仓库中的问题。然而真实的软件工作更为复杂：任务会被中断、重新分配、审查，并从其他智能体或工程师留下的部分完成状态中恢复。我们通过“交接债务”这一概念研究这一缺失的维度：即当前任者的工作不透明或不完整时所产生的重新发现成本。我们的接管协议在确定性的交接点中断编码智能体，冻结代码仓库，并在四种交接视图下评估后继智能体：仅仓库状态、原始轨迹、摘要笔记和结构化笔记。在75个源任务上，该协议生成了181个交接点任务，每个后继模型进行724次接管运行。在三个后继模型上，相对于仅基于仓库状态的接管，包含上下文的交接使智能体事件中位数减少20-59%，累积提示词令牌减少42-63%。而解决率的提升较小且依赖于具体模型。
tldr: 该论文提出“交接债务”概念，通过在确定性交接点中断编码智能体的接管协议实验，证明包含上下文的交接（如原始轨迹、结构化笔记）相比仅交接仓库状态可将后继智能体的重新发现成本降低20-59%的事件数和42-63%的提示词令牌。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "handoff debt" and demonstrates through a takeover protocol that interrupts coding agents at deterministic handoff points that context-bearing handoffs reduce successor agents' rediscovery costs by 20-59% in agent events and 42-63% in prompt tokens compared to repository-only takeover.
